title: VA Home Loan Guaranty VA Partial Claim Payment on a Loan in Default
content:
A VA partial claim is the amount VA pays the servicer of a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan in default to bring the loan current, owed back by the veteran as a subordinate lien. A VA partial claim on a loan in default is paid at the largest amount the partial claim room allows.

## What booking a partial claim does

Booking adds one partial claim entry to the loan's money transactions, dated today, for the amount paid. The partial claim the veteran owes VA on that loan rises by that amount, and the loan record shows the loan current again: its default is cured.

## Invocation

The partial claim is booked with the agent-side tool `record_partial_claim_d52e4f0e`. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). Each call books one partial claim entry.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | The reference number of the veteran's VA home loan record in default, as returned by the loan lookup for this veteran | Identifier |
| `amount` | The partial claim VA pays | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

### Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `loan_txn_id` (the reference number of the new partial claim entry), `loan_id` (the loan concerned), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the partial claim paid), `partial_claim_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, the partial claim now owed on the loan), `loan_status` (always `active` once the default is cured) and `transaction_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no other outcome.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

On a loan whose partial claim owed was 0.00, a call with `amount` 44,000.00 returns `amount` 44,000.00, `partial_claim_balance` 44,000.00, `loan_status` `active` and today's `transaction_date`; the loan's money transactions then show the partial claim entry.
